Intelligent driving assistance Set ACC Set ICA After adaptive cruise control (ACC) is turned on, the system will detect the information of vehicle ahead, and activate cruise control (no vehicle ahead) or automatically follow the vehicle ahead (if any) Setting steps: 1. Set the gear lever to "D" position, and move the lever toward "D" position once to activate the ACC 2. Adjust the cruise speed by scrolling the scroll wheel of the steering wheel up or down 3. Adjust the following distance by moving the scroll wheel of the steering wheel left or right ICA can automatically activate following vehicle ahead during cruise control and keep the vehicle traveling in the middle of the lane Setting steps: Set the gear lever to "D" position, and move the lever toward "D" position twice to activate ICA Only some intelligent driving functions are listed. Please refer to the Owner's Manual for other intelligent driving functions. Intelligent driving functions can only assist the driver in safe driving and are not applicable in all cases. Emergency treatment If the vehicle key is not functional, you can unlock the vehicle in an emergency using the following methods Trunk emergency unlocking 1. Slowly pull up the left front door to the max opening angle and hold it. 2. Insert the mechanical key into the driver's door lock hole. 3. Turn the mechanical key to unlock or lock the driver-side door. After unlocking, pull the door handle to open the driver-side door. Pull up the unlocking handle, and tilt the seat back forward. Toggle the emergency unlocking switch. 1. Fold down the seat back 2. Unlock and open the liftgate Electric power system fault indicator lamp If the electric power system fault indicator lamp on the instrument panel comes on, pull over and ask for advice by calling GAC Brand customer service hotline. 12V low voltage supply system fault warning lamp If the 12V low-voltage power supply system fault warning indicator on the instrument cluster illuminates, please refer to the Owner’s Manual to attempt a jump start, or contact the GAC Brand customer service hotline for assistance.

content: 8. Call for rescue E-Call Press and hold the SOS button for 2-5 seconds, and call the emergency aid center. Within 5 seconds after the SOS button is released, short press the SOS button to cancel E-Call. The call to the emergency aid center cannot be canceled once the SOS button has been released for more than 5 seconds; the emergency aid center is the only one who can end the call.
